items.name: Cell cape
items.blurb: a grid of violet cells dissolving toward the hem, a wave of light running down what is left.

items.name: Void cape
items.blurb: an eclipse in a corona of sixteen cells; one burns at a time as it circles.

items.name: Ring cape
items.blurb: the VOID ring as a silver seal pressed into cloth, in any colour you like.

items.name: Origin cape
items.blurb: charcoal herringbone, silver thread and one travelling stitch of light. Every account has one.

items.name: Dusk cape
items.blurb: the last light over the hills: a crescent moon, early stars, fireflies over the dark.

items.name: Static cape
items.blurb: a dead channel on an old set, until the VOID ring surfaces through the snow.

items.name: Ember wings
items.blurb: long dark feathers, warm at the tips. They glide when you fall.

items.name: Void wings
items.blurb: black glass membranes with violet veins of light.

items.name: Orbit
items.blurb: a cold ring of cells turning slowly behind you.

items.name: Monarch crown
items.blurb: worked old gold with a warm stone at the front and three smaller ones round it.

items.name: Wool beanie
items.blurb: ribbed, folded once, in any colour you like.

items.name: Top hat
items.blurb: black felt with a violet band.

items.name: Seraph halo
items.blurb: a ring of warm light that rises and settles as you breathe.

items.name: Void halo
items.blurb: a violet ring with two motes in orbit.

items.name: Ice visor
items.blurb: a slim band of cold light across the eyes.

items.name: Rift mask
items.blurb: a dark faceplate split by a violet seam.

items.name: Wave
items.blurb: a hand, raised and shaken.

items.name: Clap
items.blurb: three claps, unhurried.

items.name: Bow
items.blurb: a slow, formal bow.

items.name: Salute
items.blurb: a crisp salute to the other side.

items.name: Shrug
items.blurb: both shoulders, no comment.

items.name: Sit
items.blurb: sit down wherever you stand, until you move.

items.name: Spark trail
items.blurb: violet cells that shrink and fade behind you.

items.name: Ember trail
items.blurb: warm motes drifting up and out.

items.name: Frost trail
items.blurb: cold flakes that settle where you step.

items.name: Stair trail
items.blurb: jade cells that climb in even steps.

items.name: Founder
items.blurb: for the players who were here first. Not for sale.

items.name: VOID player
items.blurb: the VOID ring before your name. Every account has one.

items.name: Cell badge
items.blurb: a three-by-three mark before your name.

items.name: Frost badge
items.blurb: three cold cells beside your name.
